title: Ja ali asghar
body:
jaa ali asghar jaa
<<DIVIDER>>
ashoor ke din ali asghar ko
maa ro ro kar samjhati hai
tujhe aakhri jang ladna hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhe laaj meri rakhna hai
tujhe baba sang jaana hai
tujhe aakhri jang ladna hai
<<DIVIDER>>
is din ke liye hi maa teri
tujhe karbobala may laayi thi
is din ke liye hi beta
tujhe naaz se maa ne paala
tujhe aakhri jang ladna hai
jaa ali asghar jaa
ashoor ke din...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu maa ka raaj dulaara hai
tu sab ki aankh ka taara hai
tu sher e khuda ka pota
tera naam ali hai beta
tujhe aakhri jang ladna hai
ashoor ke din...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa laal tere kapde badlun
maqtal ke liye tayyaar karun
aa chehra choom loo tera
jee bhar ke dekh loo beta
tujhe aakhri jang ladna hai
jaa ali asghar jaa
ashoor ke din...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi godh may zainab leti hai
kabhi pyaar sakina karti hai
qaimon may shor hai barpa
tu sab ki dua leta jaa
tujhe aakhri jang ladna hai
ashoor ke din...
<<DIVIDER>>
maidan may ali ban kar jaana
baba ki nusrat farmaana
shabbir ka tu hai beta
abbas chacha hai tera
tujhe aakhri jang ladna hai
jaa ali asghar jaa
ashoor ke din...
<<DIVIDER>>
har maa ne di qurbani hai
tujhe meri laaj nibhani hai
jab zaalim teer chalaye
baba ko na lagne paaye
tujhe aakhri jang ladna hai
ashoor ke din...
author: N. Sarwar & J. Jaffri
